title: Generate Starship prompt from active NixOS modules
description: Add myPrompt home-manager options so profiles can inject badges and enable dynamic Starship modules (k8s, gcloud, aws). Work profile shows Pattern badge + cloud context. Format string is generated at Nix build time.
close_reason: Added myPrompt home-manager options (badges, kubernetes, gcloud, aws) to terminal.nix. Work profile injects Pattern badge and enables cloud context modules. Format string is generated at Nix build time. Both hosts eval and dry-build cleanly.
